symbols.name: control vector
symbols.meaning: The control vector, with one entry $\phi_T$ for each triple $T$.
symbols.quote: Write $\phi$ for the control vector, with entries $\phi_T$ at triples $T$, and $\mathcal{Y}$ for the target vector, with entries $\mathcal{Y}_S$.

symbols.name: target vector
symbols.meaning: The target vector, with one entry $\mathcal{Y}_S$ for each triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Write $\phi$ for the control vector, with entries $\phi_T$ at triples $T$, and $\mathcal{Y}$ for the target vector, with entries $\mathcal{Y}_S$.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set.
symbols.quote: Write $S$ and $T$ for triples, which are three-element subsets of the ground set.

symbols.name: starting side values
symbols.meaning: The vector of starting values of the side wires $A_{ST}$.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathcal{L}$ and $\mathcal{M}$ for the vectors of starting values of the side wires and of the central wires.

symbols.name: starting central values
symbols.meaning: The vector of starting values of the central wires $C_\ell$.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathcal{L}$ and $\mathcal{M}$ for the vectors of starting values of the side wires and of the central wires.

symbols.name: copy map
symbols.meaning: The map that adds $\phi_T$ to the side wire $A_{ST}$ of each neighbouring pair.
symbols.quote: $\mathcal{K}$ is copy, which adds $\phi_T$ to $A_{ST}$ for each neighbouring pair.

symbols.name: side injection
symbols.meaning: The map that adds to $\mathcal{Y}_S$ the side wires $A_{ST}$ over the neighbours $T$ of $S$.
symbols.quote: $\mathcal{O}$ is side injection, which adds to $\mathcal{Y}_S$ the side wires $A_{ST}$ over the neighbours $T$ of $S$.

symbols.name: gather map
symbols.meaning: The map that adds $\phi_T$ to the central wire $C_\ell$ for each $\ell\in T$.
symbols.quote: $\mathcal{Z}$ is gather, which adds $\phi_T$ to $C_\ell$ for each $\ell\in T$.

symbols.name: scatter map
symbols.meaning: The map that adds to $\mathcal{Y}_S$ the central wires $C_\ell$ with $\ell\in S$.
symbols.quote: $\mathcal{R}$ is scatter, which adds to $\mathcal{Y}_S$ the central wires $C_\ell$ with $\ell\in S$.
